title.narrative: Integrated multi-sector assistance to support anticipatory drought response in Dugda Dawa woreda of West Guji zone, Oromia region.

description.narrative: ltpgtltbrgtMultiple overlapping humanitarian crises such as ongoing latent conflict and climate shocks including prolonged drought and floods, have increased significantly humanitarian needs. The HRP 2024 targets more than 15.5 million people in Ethiopia that are in need of humanitarian assistance. Climate shocks, including drought and floods are still threatening the life of vulnerable people and restricted access to basic needs and services in several zones of the country. The project targets Oromia region, West Guji zone, Dugda Dawa woreda to address the impact of recurrent and anticipatory drought effect.ltbrgtThe project aims to support for drought vulnerable community and reduce the effect of anticipatory drought in Oromia region, West Guji zone Oromia region, with living with limited access to basic services provided from the humanitarian partners and governmental structures. The multi sectoral and integrated response in alignment with the 2nd Reserve allocation of EHF covers the sectors of Health, Nutrition and Agriculture and complement the CERF effort in the targeted woreda. ltbrgtThe integrated intervention will address health needs by focusing on the provision of essential Primary health care services through MHNTs and strengthening system including Maternal and child health, strengthening routine and emergency immunization, support and strengthen surveillance activities and prevention and management of communicable diseases, capacity building of government health care providers, Risk communication and Community engagement, supporting the full functionality of health facilities through provision of medicines and medical supplies, minor health facilities repair and furnishing. The Nutrition section plans to provide lifesaving nutrition interventions by the integration of CMAM and IYCF-E activities through the existing health system. On another side, the agriculture sector major activities include provision of agricultural inputs, livestock veterinary drugs and multi-purpose cash for the targeted groups. ltbrgtThe main objective of WASH programs response is to reduce public health risks and scope of activities are : promoting good hygiene practices, providing safe drinking water providing appropriate sanitation facilities reducing environmental health risks and ensuring conditions that allow people to live with good health, dignity, comfort and safety. The Protection mainstreaming across the sector will include risk mitigation, and provision of GBV services, strengthening essential services for survivors of GBV, including case management and psychosocial support services. Finally, the project will target 49,587 (17,933 Women, 10,485 Girls, 11,950 Men and 9,219 Boys) beneficiaries for the period of 6 months with a total budget of USD 715,000.00.lt/pgt
